summary: Nuvve Holding Corp. filed an 8-K on May 12, 2026, disclosing a securities exchange and omnibus amendment agreement with holders of warrants covering up to 23,831,137 common shares. Holders agreed to exchange existing warrants (exercise price $0.4734) for 13,107,127 common shares or pre-funded warrants at $0.0001. This restructuring reduces warrant overhang and dilutes existing equity. No board recommendation or advisors named. The amendment also modifies Series A preferred terms. Watch for shareholder dilution impact and potential further financial restructuring steps.
